message: The other night, as the storm rolled in, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter sent a meme about preparing for hurricanes, while my son chimed in with a weather update and a cheeky emoji. We ended up sharing our favorite comfort food recipes to have on hand, just in case. It’s funny how a storm can bring out the best in us, even if it’s just through a screen. Anyone else find comfort in their family’s virtual chatter during a weather scare? 🌧️
